verdict.rationale: cubic's core product generates AI insights and suggestions from the user's own code and PR data. It flags bugs, logic errors and security issues on every PR, writes PR summaries, and answers questions about a PR and codebase in an AI chat. It also runs codebase-wide scans and builds AI wikis with architecture diagrams, and a community user praised its technical explanations. Missing for 10: the AI chat sidebar is documented only under an 'archive' path, and there is no evidence of AI-generated narrative insights over the analytics dashboard data, which is shown as metrics only.
